contract.cross_unregister: A listener can unregister another listener during active event delivery
contract.current_event_continuity: The unregistered listener still receives the current event when it was already part of the active delivery sequence
contract.post_mutation_registry: The unregister operation removes the target listener from the registry
contract.remaining_listener_preservation: Other listeners remain registered after cross-unregister
contract.subsequent_delivery: The removed listener does not receive subsequent events
contract.registry_stability: Cross-unregister during emit does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Emit and unregister operations require the events permission
